summary.title: Multi-Wing Review of an implicit absorption trace claim
summary.description: This example represents a multi-perspective review of an Origin Audit record involving possible implicit structural absorption without explicit citation.

review_context.review_trigger: The trace claim involves meaningful structural similarity without explicit citation, requiring multiple review perspectives before any dispute or allocation-readiness escalation.

wing_reviews.assessment: The later work shows a similar layered structure, including separation between observation, review, and allocation. The pattern is meaningful enough to preserve as a trace hypothesis.
uncertainty_notes: The similarity may reflect shared discourse or parallel development.
Structural resemblance alone is not sufficient to determine copying or ownership.
wing_reviews.recommended_next_step: Preserve as observed_with_uncertainty and compare against provenance findings.

wing_reviews.assessment: No explicit citation, acknowledgement, or confirmed access evidence is present in the reviewed record.
uncertainty_notes: Absence of citation does not prove intentional omission.
No direct access record is available in this example.
wing_reviews.recommended_next_step: Do not escalate to allocation-readiness review without stronger provenance evidence.

wing_reviews.assessment: The later work uses a similar conceptual distinction between trace, ownership, and allocation, but the terminology is not identical.
uncertainty_notes: Conceptual overlap may arise from common field-level discussion.
The reviewed similarity is stronger at the structural level than at the exact wording level.
wing_reviews.recommended_next_step: Treat conceptual overlap as supporting evidence, not as a standalone origin determination.

wing_reviews.assessment: No formal dispute is currently registered in the source audit record, but the claim could become disputed if used for ownership or allocation purposes.
uncertainty_notes: The absence of a current dispute does not guarantee future agreement.
Escalation may be required if a claimant or respondent contests the record.
wing_reviews.recommended_next_step: Keep dispute_status.is_disputed as false, but preserve escalation notes.

wing_reviews.assessment: The trace claim is not ready for allocation review because evidence remains uncertain and no direct citation or contribution weighting review is available.
uncertainty_notes: Implicit absorption requires additional review before allocation-readiness can be considered.
Preliminary trace observation must not be converted into payment or allocation signals.
wing_reviews.recommended_next_step: Do not proceed to Allocation Readiness at this stage.

wing_reviews.assessment: The reviewed Origin Audit record preserves key governance boundaries and does not present itself as a verdict, legal judgment, ownership determination, or royalty allocation.
uncertainty_notes: Governance fields must remain explicit if the record is reused downstream.
Any future escalation should preserve the same safety boundaries.
wing_reviews.recommended_next_step: Maintain governance safety fields in all downstream handoff packages.

combined_review.summary: Multiple wings identify a meaningful trace hypothesis, especially at the structural level, but provenance evidence is insufficient and allocation-readiness is not recommended.
key_findings: Structural similarity is meaningful but not conclusive.
No explicit citation or confirmed access evidence is present.
Conceptual overlap exists but may reflect shared discourse.
No formal dispute is currently registered.
The case is not ready for allocation review.
recommended_next_steps: Preserve the trace claim as observed_with_uncertainty.
Do not treat the review as a verdict.
Do not proceed to allocation-readiness review at this stage.
Collect additional provenance evidence if the claim becomes disputed.
Escalate to Dispute Registry if a formal dispute emerges.

allocation_readiness.reason: The Multi-Wing Review found meaningful structural similarity but insufficient provenance evidence and no contribution weighting basis for downstream allocation review.
allocation_readiness.recommended_next_step: Maintain as an Origin Audit record and revisit only if stronger evidence or a formal dispute emerges.

dispute_notes: No formal dispute is currently registered.
If contested by either party, this record may be escalated to a Dispute Registry.

governance_notes.principle: Multi-Wing Review improves audit quality, but it does not create final authority.
